- Game Hub: the in-game menu is a set of icon tiles (performance, Do not disturb, FPS, rotation, screenshot, recording, memory, close game), the handle can be dragged to either side, and a screen cover turns the screen black (double tap to wake it).
- Game Hub: "Add a game" in the shelf's settings opens the list of the phone's apps again.
- Play Store links: Pulse can take them (root or Shizuku); an app on the phone opens on its page in the app manager.
- App uninstall: root or Shizuku removes the app at once; the lists refresh when it is gone. Icons on the app page are Fluent.
- Desktop: icons are free-placed by default, with a spacing setting; a mouse arrow follows the finger while dragging; a long press on the taskbar opens the right-click menu.
- Windows right-click menus per look (Windows 11 with an icon row and "Show more options", 10, 7, XP, 95), a Properties window (General, Details, Permissions), rename apps, and an editable order of the menu's actions.
- Launcher: assignable gestures (double tap, swipe up, swipe down), an A-Z apps list with a letter strip, an "At a glance" line under the clock, boot screen and sign-in screen on by default, and now and then a surprise BIOS screen (rarely a fake blue screen, which says it is a joke).
- Launcher: a Terminal look (black, green monospace, the apps as shell lines); the Terminal page is drawn as a terminal, with colour codes and a built-in neofetch card (the Android robot of its generation).
- Screen cover: a Neofetch page; the charging animation has a detailed neofetch card.
- Windows 7 Start menu: drawn icons for Pictures, Music and Games; the start orb is a little smaller.
- WMP 12 player: a real Now Playing page (big cover, list beside it when wide), a real Library page, six looks to choose, and the Aero look (glass title bar, glossy play button).
- Keyboard: the bar is never empty for an unknown word; shift refreshes the bar; a capital after a typed name; earlier wrong words are mended in the background; the corrected word highlight is on; a stack overflow in the selection report is fixed.
- Device: the processor, temperature, GPU load and memory read through root or Shizuku, else through open files or an estimate, so they are not stuck at 0.
- Crash fixes: a stack overflow in the keyboard; empty weather hours, media sessions without playback state and the home drop target no longer crash.
- Build: the R8 mapping of each build is kept as an artifact, so release crash reports can be read.
